messages.text:
"Game Concept: A 2D pixel-art aquarium management and simulation game featuring high-detail 56-bit / 4K pixel graphics.
​Aquarium Setup:
​Divided into two distinct sections: Predator fish racks (featuring 2 large 2-meter tanks) and small ornamental fish racks (featuring 5 separate 50cm tanks).
​Includes a holding tray system to temporarily store purchased fish or decorations before placing them into tanks.
​Fish Species:
​Predator fish: Alligator Gar, Redtail Catfish, King Kamfa Flowerhorn, Channa Maru (Yellow/Red/Royal Blue), and Arowana varieties (Silver, 24K Golden, Super Red).
​Small ornamental fish: Betta / Halfmoon / Crown Tail, Panda fish, and wild paradise fish (cá lia thia đồng).
​Feeding @COMMENT_BODY@ Care Mechanics:
​Predator fish strictly accept live prey, bloodworms, or fresh shrimp (no fish pellets). Small fish accept pellets, worms, and shrimp.
​Food has limited uses and must be purchased from the shop when depleted.
​Features a tank cleaning system, water inspection zoom mode, and a breeding/mating system where paired adult fish produce eggs that hatch and grow over time.
​Economy @COMMENT_BODY@ UI:
​Currency is measured in Vietnamese Dong (VNĐ). Fish periodically drop paper money that can be collected.
​Clean UI layout: Food menu stacked vertically on the left, and a compact VNĐ bank balance displayed at the top-right corner.
​Decoration System:
​Ability to purchase driftwood, rocks, and aquatic plants, store them in the tray, drag and drop them to custom positions inside the tank, and confirm placement.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
